requirements.name: strict-h1-wire-rejection
requirements.required_api: Public strict codec option rejecting continuation lines in request headers AND trailers before normalization or origin admission; original error offset retained; no lenient fallback.
requirements.current_boundary: Envoy parsed-map filters have lost continuation syntax. Released llhttp rejects it through maintained incremental C API but supplies no complete H2/TLS/identity gateway.
requirements.positive: Valid unfolded headers/trailers, exact encoded target and ordered pipeline remain valid; no early origin effect for staged late-invalid requests.
requirements.policy_vs_protocol: AegisGate requires rejection rather than permissive normalization; the missing stricter option alone is not a vendor vulnerability claim.

requirements.name: h2-authority-response-before-reset
requirements.required_api: Supported invalid-authority decision callback after bounded pseudoheader decoding but before irreversible reset, with verified downstream SNI and a safe HTTP400/421 response path; never forward malformed authority.
requirements.current_boundary: override_stream_error_on_invalid_http_message changes termination scope, not HTTP status. Local reply requires decoded headers; inspected UHV extension is hidden/unsupported.
requirements.positive: Valid authority, Host/SNI denial, encoded targets and reused H2 origin identity controls retain existing assertions.
requirements.policy_vs_protocol: AegisGate400/421 is a project response contract; a peer PROTOCOL_ERROR reset is not by itself a vendor security vulnerability.

requirements.name: h2-error-serialization-before-close
requirements.required_api: Supported public codec error submission and adapter-send completion before HCM closes; exposes actual protocol error code and bounded close/flush result, preserving all three exact frame negatives.
requirements.current_boundary: ProcessBytes may return before adapter Send; ordinary goAway submits NO_ERROR; protocolErrorForTest is not a supported runtime API. A network buffer flush cannot serialize unsent codec frames.
requirements.positive: No CONTINUATION regression, valid reuse/gRPC/cancellation/backpressure and the two already repaired malformed-header cases.
requirements.policy_vs_protocol: Malformed frame handling must be compared with RFC9113 error scope and GOAWAY/close requirements; the project additionally requires observable peer error frames within its unchanged bounded oracle. No unsupported universal conformance claim.

requirements.name: authoritative-runtime-effects
requirements.required_api: Authenticated pre-wire admission/dispatch ledger with stable downstream connection+stream, verified SNI/tenant/signed generation, origin dial+connection+stream assignment, all HEADERS/CONTINUATION/DATA and HPACK mutations, final decision/cancellation, sequence/coverage/loss commitments.
requirements.current_boundary: Transport/httptrace/Framer/HPACK permit bounded correlation, not complete authoritative proxy dispatch, signed generation or exact HPACK mutation coverage. Trusted record signers can omit events.
requirements.positive: Every raw origin byte remains visible, including SETTINGS ACK with no downstream request. Missing, aliased, reordered or lost coverage is INCOMPLETE.
requirements.policy_vs_protocol: Research causality is a proposed AegisGate security property, not an HTTP2 conformance requirement or replacement for the current aggregate zero-byte contract.
